# Chloe Armitage

Pre-award officer in the Corvane grants office. She is the group's contact for every outgoing application and for the financial side of awarded grants.

## Role

Chloe builds the official budget from the group's resource sheet, checks eligibility against each funder's rules, and routes applications to the institute director for sign-off. She also prepares the financial statements for grant reports. She covers the life sciences groups on the second floor, about fifteen PIs.

## How We Work Together

- Ines sends her a call at least eight weeks before the deadline; Chloe replies with an eligibility note and a budget skeleton within a week.
- She works from the [[aurora-budget-sheet]] rather than from email figures, and asks that only [[priya-raman]] or Ines edit the resource tab.
- She is precise about internal deadlines: the grants office needs the complete package ten working days before the funder deadline. The steps are written up in [[internal-grant-review-and-sign-off]].
- She prefers a short call to long email threads when a budget line is disputed.

## Current Threads

- [[aurora-programme-grant-2027]]: budget at 2.41 M EUR after the [[aurora-budget-review-2026-10-15]]; she flagged that the Foundation does not pay overhead on equipment, which moved the plasma proteomics instrument time into a service line in Marta's group.
- [[frontier-interim-report]]: financial statement slot to book for May 2027.
- She attended the [[aurora-mock-panel-2026-09-29]] as process observer and timed the presentations.

## History

- Ran the budget and sign-off for the [[frontier-starting-grant]] in 2025, including the late correction of the salary scale after the January 2025 pay agreement.
- Joined the [[aurora-kickoff-2026-06-10]].

## Notes

Chloe keeps the grants office's own record of submissions; when dates in this vault and in her system differ, hers is the official one.
